explication: Nuvio Live Sports is a Nuvio/Stremio live-sports addon: clients request a catalog or select a match stream, the addon aggregates provider fixtures and stream choices, and the resolver can unlock protected sources before playback. The README also documents replay collections, personalized configuration, image handling, and manifest proxying. The sampled excerpts do not show most application wiring, so links for those capabilities reflect README documentation; the resolver HTTP dispatch is directly evidenced in source.
